description: Lists the announced DJ nights in one djbnb city tonight or this weekend: time, night, venue, door price when known, and the DJs on the bill, each with its djbnb link. Start times are local to the city.

city.description: A city name such as Detroit or Salt Lake City, or a slug from list_cities such as detroit-mi.

when.description: tonight (the default) or this_weekend (Friday to Sunday).

name: whos_playing
title: Who is playing tonight
